items.notes: Two staggered columns linked by a stepped connector line match official metaphor; legible at all sizes.

items.name: Single column
items.rationale: One field column has a header and an empty body.
items.notes: Single column rectangle with top header divider and open body matches source; distinct from inline column.

items.name: All inside borders
items.rationale: A table shows both interior horizontal and vertical borders.
items.notes: Four outer corner brackets with full interior + cross; clearly distinct from single-axis horizontal/vertical border variants.

items.name: Inside horizontal border
items.rationale: A table highlights its interior horizontal border.
items.notes: Four outer corner brackets framing a single interior horizontal border line; unmistakable vs inside-all and inside-vertical.

items.name: Inside vertical border
items.rationale: A table highlights its interior vertical border.

items.name: Show borderless cells
items.rationale: An eye reveals a cell with no visible borders.
items.notes: Dashed borderless-cell square with bottom-right eye icon matches official source; legible at all sizes.

items.name: Calculator brackets
items.rationale: A calculator is grouped inside a pair of brackets.

items.name: Calculator brackets number symbol
items.rationale: A grouped calculator has an explicit number-symbol marker.

items.name: Multiple calculators in brackets
items.rationale: Two calculators appear together inside brackets.
items.notes: Two calculators inside square brackets clearly distinguish multiple from single calculator-brackets; legible at all sizes.

items.name: Multiple calculators in brackets with number symbol
items.rationale: Grouped calculators share a number-symbol marker.
items.notes: Two bracketed calculators with circular # badge at bottom-right match source; clear at all sizes.

items.name: Edit branch
items.rationale: A pencil edits a branching path.

items.name: Calculator triangle
items.rationale: A calculator sits beside a triangular geometry tool.
items.notes: Calculator paired with overlapping triangle at bottom-right matches official source; legible at all sizes.

items.name: Bar chart phone
items.rationale: A bar chart is viewed beside a phone.
items.notes: Three vertical data bars on baseline beside a smartphone with top bezel and home bar; clear and distinct at all sizes.

items.name: Database sync
items.rationale: Opposing arrows circulate around a synchronized database.
items.notes: Database cylinder encircled by opposing top and bottom sync arrows clearly conveys database sync; legible at all sizes.

items.name: Database asterisk
items.rationale: An asterisk marks a layered database.

items.name: Protected list
items.rationale: A shield protects a three-row list.
items.notes: Horizontal list lines protected by a bottom-right checkmark shield match official source; crisp at all sizes.

items.name: Lock circle
items.rationale: A circular boundary encloses a closed padlock.

items.name: Protected database
items.rationale: A padlock protects a compact data store.
items.notes: Closed padlock paired with a bottom-right database cylinder matches official source; legible at all sizes.

items.name: Location ribbon
items.rationale: A location target is marked with a small award ribbon.

items.name: Trophy prohibited
items.rationale: A prohibition mark overlays an award trophy.
items.notes: Award trophy cup with bottom-right circle-slash prohibition badge matches source; clear at all sizes.

items.name: Locked columns
items.rationale: Three vertical columns are protected by a lock.
items.notes: Three vertical columns with bottom-right padlock match source; clearly distinguished from locked-rows by vertical dividers.

items.name: Locked rows
items.rationale: Three horizontal rows are protected by a lock.

items.name: Stack key
items.rationale: A key grants access to a stack of records.
items.notes: Stacked record layers paired with a bottom-right access key match official source; legible at all sizes.

items.name: Table wand
items.rationale: A wand transforms a grid of table cells.

items.name: Toggle sparkles
items.rationale: Two switches are accompanied by sparkling automation.
items.notes: Two stacked toggle switches with sparkle stars match official source; crisp at all sizes.

items.name: Window asterisk
items.rationale: A window contains a prominent asterisk.
items.notes: Browser window with prominent centered 6-spoked asterisk; crisp and distinct from fabric-sample.

items.name: Window checkmark
items.rationale: A successful window has a checkmark badge.
items.notes: Window with content lines and circular checkmark badge in bottom-right; legible at all sizes.

items.name: Window pulse
items.rationale: A monitored window plots a pulse on chart axes.
items.notes: Titled application window displaying a pulse waveform on axes matches official source; legible at all sizes.

items.name: Calendar clock
items.rationale: A clock marks the time of a scheduled calendar date.

items.name: Calendar lightning
items.rationale: A lightning bolt marks an urgent calendar event.

items.name: Calendar arrow up
items.rationale: An upward arrow lifts a calendar date.

items.name: Calendar link
items.rationale: A link connects two calendar pages.

items.name: Calendar person
items.rationale: A person stands beside a month schedule.
items.notes: Person silhouette standing beside a month calendar grid matches official concept; legible at all sizes.

items.name: Calendar prohibited
items.rationale: A prohibition mark blocks a calendar date.

items.name: Calendar signal
items.rationale: A calendar broadcasts a scheduled signal.

items.name: Data graph
items.rationale: Two independent series run across a chart with horizontal and vertical axes.
items.notes: Two independent plotted curves on horizontal and vertical axes match official source; crisp at all sizes.

items.name: Data tree
items.rationale: Three branches connect separate records to a shared data store.

items.name: Double pie chart
items.rationale: One complete pie and two detached pieces make a split distribution.

items.name: Progress bars
items.rationale: Two horizontal tracks show different completion amounts.
items.notes: Two stacked horizontal progress tracks with distinct hatched fill levels match official source; crisp at all sizes.

items.name: Stream search
items.rationale: A magnifier inspects three separate flowing data strands.
items.notes: Magnifying glass inspecting three parallel flowing data streams matches official source; legible at all sizes.

items.name: Histogram function
items.rationale: A distribution of bars is paired with an explicit function curve.

items.name: Connected nodes
items.rationale: A central hub connects to three separate outer nodes.
items.notes: Central hub node connected by spokes to three outer nodes matches official source; crisp at all sizes.
